title: nan
authors: Chatziparaschis D.; Lagoudakis M.G.; Partsinevelos P.
key_contribution: Presents a synchronous UAV-humanoid robot collaboration for autonomous mapping and navigation in GNSS-denied search and rescue using SLAM, OctoMap, and adaptive Monte-Carlo localization, validated in a proof-of-concept.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Deep_Learning_Odometry to ensure precise positioning.
